questions.q: What comes next? DEF, IJK, NOP, STU, …
questions.why: Each group starts 5 letters after the last one, with the same pattern inside: XYZ. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statements: All rivers are lakes. No lakes are ponds. Conclusions: I. All rivers are ponds. II. Some rivers are ponds.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II need not be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: godabim = kidney stones; romzbim = kidney beans; romzbako = wax beans. Which word could mean 'wax statue'?
questions.why: bim = kidney, romz = beans, bako = wax; the noun comes first, so 'statue' + bako. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: A Five-Day Suspension is for (1) physically assaulting someone or (2) wilfully damaging or defacing school property. Which is the best example?
opts: Lillian is caught cheating a second time
Marc is sent out for disruptions
Franny spray-paints insults on the locker-room wall and is suspended
Failing students must stay for tutoring
questions.why: Defacing school property meets condition (2). GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

questions.q: If PENCIL is written as NKEPGR in a certain code, how is HOSPITAL written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward and the word is then reversed: HOSPITAL → NCVKRUQJ. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Q is the brother of P. R is the daughter of P. S is the sister of Q. T is the mother of S. How is T related to R?
questions.why: P, Q and S are siblings and T is their mother. R is P's daughter, so T is R's grandmother.

questions.q: The present ages of Meera and Deepak are in the ratio 3 : 5. After 2 years the ratio will be 13 : 21. What is Deepak's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 3k and 5k: (3k + 2)/(5k + 2) = 13/21 gives k = 8, so Deepak is 40. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statements: Some cats are dogs. All dogs are pets. Conclusions: I. All cats are pets. II. Some pets are cats.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II must be true. GPSC-style practice item.
